blocks.text: 38 שַׁחֲרִית לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 38
blocks.layout: running head, centered title with page numbers both sides

blocks.text:
עֻזֵּנוּ צוּר מִשְׂגַּבֵּנוּ. מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִשְׂגָּב בַּעֲדֵנוּ: אֵל בָּרוּךְ גְּדוֹל
דֵּעָה. הֵכִין וּפָעַל זָהֳרֵי חַמָּה. טוֹב יָצַר כָּבוֹד לִשְׁמוֹ. מְאוֹרוֹת
נָתַן סְבִיבוֹת עֻזּוֹ. פִּנּוֹת צְבָאָיו קְדוֹשִׁים רוֹמְמֵי שַׁדַּי. תָּמִיד
מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד־אֵל וּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ: תִּתְבָּרַךְ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־שֶׁבַח
מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ. וְעַל־מְאוֹרֵי־אוֹר שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ יְפָאֲרוּךָ סֶּלָה:
blocks.layout: prose paragraph continued from previous page, 5 lines, justified; full-width rule below
centered, small Rashi type, below rule

blocks.text:
זְכוּת וּמִישׁוֹר לִפְנֵי כִסְאוֹ. חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כְבוֹדוֹ: טוֹבִים
מְאוֹרוֹת שֶׁבָּרָא אֱלֹהֵינוּ. יְצָרָם בְּדַעַת בְּבִינָה וּבְהַשְׂכֵּל: כֹּחַ
וּגְבוּרָה נָתַן בָּהֶם. לִהְיוֹת מוֹשְׁלִים בְּקֶרֶב תֵּבֵל: מְלֵאִים זִיו
וּמְפִיקִים נֹגַהּ. נָאֶה זִיוָם בְּכָל־הָעוֹלָם: שְׂמֵחִים בְּצֵאתָם
וְשָׂשִׂים בְּבוֹאָם. עוֹשִׂים בְּאֵימָה רְצוֹן קוֹנָם: פְּאֵר וְכָבוֹד
נוֹתְנִים לִשְׁמוֹ. צָהֳלָה וְרִנָּה לְזֵכֶר מַלְכוּתוֹ: קָרָא לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ
וַיִּזְרַח אוֹר. רָאָה וְהִתְקִין צוּרַת הַלְּבָנָה: שֶׁבַח נוֹתְנִים־לוֹ כָּל־
צְבָא מָרוֹם. תִּפְאֶרֶת וּגְדֻלָּה שְׂרָפִים וְאוֹפַנִּים וְחַיּוֹת הַקֹּדֶשׁ:
blocks.layout: prose paragraph, 8 lines, no indent (starts mid-poem); no acrostic letters marked

blocks.text:
לָאֵל אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי הִתְעַלָּה
וְיָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדוֹ. תִּפְאֶרֶת עָטָה לְיוֹם הַמְּנוּחָה עֹנֶג
קָרָא לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת: זֶה שֶׁבַח שֶׁלַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שֶׁבּוֹ שָׁבַת אֵל
מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ: וְיוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְשַׁבֵּחַ וְאוֹמֵר מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר
לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת לַיְיָ: לְפִיכָךְ יְפָאֲרוּ וִיבָרְכוּ לָאֵל
כָּל־יְצוּרָיו. שֶׁבַח יְקָר וּגְדֻלָּה יִתְּנוּ לָאֵל מֶלֶךְ יוֹצֵר כֹּל
הַמַּנְחִיל מְנוּחָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קֹדֶשׁ:
שִׁמְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִתְקַדַּשׁ. וְזִכְרְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ יִתְפָּאַר. בַּשָּׁמַיִם
מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת: תִּתְבָּרַךְ מוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ עַל־שֶׁבַח
מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ. וְעַל־מְאוֹרֵי־אוֹר שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ יְפָאֲרוּךָ סֶּלָה:
blocks.layout: new paragraph, first line indented, 10 lines

blocks.text: 38 Morning Prayer for the New Year 38

Lord of our might, Rock of our fortress, shield of our salva-
tion, a fortress around us. Blessed God, great in knowledge,
He has prepared and made the sun's rays, the Benevolent has
fashioned glory for His Name, lights has He placed around
His might, the chiefs of His hosts are holy, exalting the
Almighty, constantly do they recount the honour of God and
His holiness. Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, for the glory
of Thy handiwork, and for the radiant lights that Thou hast
made, they shall glorify Thee, Selah.
blocks.layout: prose paragraph continued from previous page, 9 lines; full-width rule below

blocks.text:
before His throne, grace and compassion before His glory.
Good are the lights which our God has created, He has
formed them with knowledge, reason and understanding.
Power and strength has He placed in them that they may
reign in the midst of the world. They are full of lustre and
brightly shine, comely is their lustre over the whole world.
They rejoice when they go forth and are jubilant when they
come in and fulfil in awe the will of their Owner. Glory and
honour do they give to His Name, joy and delight at the
mention of His Kingdom. He called to the sun, then light
shone forth, He saw and decreed the shape of the moon.
Praise does the whole host of heaven bestow on Him, fame
and grandeur the Seraphim, Ophanim and holy Hayoth.
blocks.layout: prose paragraph, 13 lines, no indent (starts mid-sentence)
Hebrew cue word at start of indented paragraph

blocks.text:
To the God who rested from all His works on the
seventh day, He rose and was seated on the throne of His
glory, He draped Himself in splendour for the day of rest,
a delight did He call the Sabbath day. This is the praise of
the seventh day that on it God rested from all His work.
And the seventh day praises and says: a psalm of the Sabbath
day, it is good to thank the Lord. Therefore do all His
creatures glorify and bless God, praise, honour and grandeur
do they offer to God, the King, the Creator of all, who has
bestowed rest as an inheritance upon His people Israel in
His holiness on the Holy Sabbath day. Thy Name. O Lord
our God, be sanctified and Thy memory, O our King, be
glorified in heaven above and on the earth below. Blessed
art Thou, our Helper, for the glory of Thy handiwork and
for the radiant lights that Thou hast made, they shall praise
Thee, Selah.
